decision.title: Bug-autofix agent: superseded by the productivity-stack hub fix-bot cockpit (Phase 18 / DDR-0038)
decision.rationale: The standalone runner planned for this repo (scripts/fix-agent/ + its own launchd job, state machine, kill switch and alerting) was replaced by a hub scheduler kind. Both repos run on the same box, so a second ops stack here would duplicate infrastructure the hub already has and that is reachable from a phone over the tailnet. What stayed in THIS repo is the brain: .claude/skills/bug-autofix/ (SKILL.md + pr-template.md), because codebase knowledge belongs with the codebase. The guard architecture, the maude-fixbot machine identity, PR-only-no-auto-merge-forever, repro-first, and labels-as-claim-mechanism all carried over into the hub implementation. Verified on contact with the installed CLI 2.1.222: --max-turns does not exist (the cap is --max-budget-usd), and --tools is a real positive gate over built-ins.
